routes.name: R_FW289_FINITE_ONLY
routes.retired_because: Finite length/dimension/tail testing cannot establish the all-parameter claim or exact scalar freeness.

C9000289.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 289 (Strong Kadison–Kastler stability and its spatial boundaries.; papers: Universal strong Kadison–Kastler stability; Near Inclusions of von Neumann Algebras Without Small Spatial Embeddings; Close Separable C*-Algebras Without Spatial Conjugacy; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/289.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FW289.statement: For every r>=1, sufficiently large d depending only on r, all scalar-free unital copies of M_d with normalized trace, and every r-label multiset W: ||B_W|| is bounded by the manuscript beta_W, with constant 7 sqrt((r-1)!) for distinct labels.

C_TL289.statement: For every finite N there is one threshold d_0(N) giving sum_(W containing a) beta_W^2<=64 for every label a and all 1<=r<=N, with each multiset counted once.

C_CUT289.statement: The reduced-free-product model, exact cut decomposition, label-independent source projections, tensor reversals, arbitrary tails, and d^(-(p+q)/2) factorization in equations fw-fock through fw-cut-factorization are valid.

C_TUPLE289.statement: Distinct-label scalar tuple matrices have norm sqrt(p!q!), and missing-label projection matrices are contractions before normalized permutation replication; preservation is bounded by sqrt(p!q!)(1+sqrt((p+1)(q+1))/d).

C_COMB289.statement: The reciprocal-binomial sum is at most 5 for every length; scalar restoration and repeated-label counting give the manuscript H_r, C_r and A_r bounds and a finite simultaneous threshold.

C_MATCH289.statement: For arbitrary multiplicities, A+B+{a}=W determines either submultiset from the other and a. The induced edge-coordinate maps are injective, so nonnegative input-label energy is not overcounted. All-ones order replication has squared coefficient mn, attained on constants; the scalar tail and product defects are nonnegative.

C_MULTI289.statement: For all scalar-free equiprobable projection partitions and all label multisets, the explicit dimension threshold in report.md gives ||B_W||<=5 sqrt((r-1)!)d^(-(r-1)/2) and the common through-label squared sum <=26, simultaneously through any finite N.

C_UNIVERSAL289.statement: For every epsilon>0 a universal delta>0 makes any two unital von Neumann algebras on any complex Hilbert space at KK distance below delta conjugate by a unitary u with ||u-I||<epsilon (Universal manuscript thm:main).

C_AMP289.statement: An absolute C_amp bounds ||ad_h|M||_cb by C_amp ||ad_h|M|| for every separably acting II_1 factor, every representation and selfadjoint h (thm:amplification).

C_COLUMN289.statement: For every unital represented Cstar algebra A and h, ||([h,a_i])||_col <=8 ||ad_h|A|| ||(a_i)||_col (lem:column-commutator).

C_LIFTS289.statement: For every matrix level n, P=M_n(M) has an ultrapower Haar unitary scalar-free from P with full-matrix unitary lifts s_j satisfying ||[I_n tensor h,s_j]||<=2||ad_h|M|| (lem:free-lifts).

C_SCALAR_RECOVERY289.statement: The controlled lifts, clipping and scalar recovery arguments after cor:through-label imply the claimed positive scalar weak limit detecting all matrix commutators; this downstream burden is not settled by the present mission.

C_BOUNDARY289.statement: The boundary correction, intertwiner and diagonal-unitary implications lem:boundary-correction, lem:boundary-intertwiner and lem:boundary-diagonal-unitary hold with their stated uniform bounds (Section 04).

C_FINITE289.statement: The finite-factor uniform stability theorem thm:finite follows with uniform constants as stated in Section 05.

C_MODULAR289.statement: Prepared-pair, modular-graph/cut and modular-alignment implications (prop:prepared-pair, prop:modular-graphs, cor:modular-cuts, prop:modular-alignment) and normalizer correction in Sections 06-07 are valid.

C_CORE289.statement: Core descent prop:core-descent and the uniform separably acting factor theorem thm:factors hold as stated in Section 08.

C_REDUCTIONS289.statement: Center matching, fiber-gap, measurable implementers, separable tests and thm:separable-algebras in Section 09 extend the factor theorem to the full arbitrary-cardinality main theorem.

C_NEAR289.statement: There are common-identity von Neumann pairs M_n,N_n on separable H_n with one-sided gap gamma(M_n,N_n)->0, but a fixed epsilon_0>0 lower-bounds ||u-I|| for every spatial embedding u M_n u* subset N_n for all sufficiently large n (Near-Inclusions thm:main).

C_NEAR_CONSTRUCTION289.statement: The uniform Fourier circle construction prop:circle and near-inclusion estimate prop:near convert a vanishing unitary commutator into vanishing one-sided gap.

C_CLOCK_CORNER289.statement: The clock/shift obstruction lem:clock and corner recovery lem:corner rule out small spatial embeddings despite the small commutator.

C_CSTAR289.statement: For every epsilon>0 there exist common-identity norm-separable Cstar algebras A,B on a separable H with KK(A,B)<epsilon and A''=B'', but no unitary spatially conjugates A and B (Cstar manuscript thm:main).

C_CSTAR_INVARIANT289.statement: The sequence-space invariant prop:sequences/lem:invariant/cor:obstruction and the tree deformation lem:tree give the claimed nonconjugacy obstruction.

C_CSTAR_NORM289.statement: Absorption, ambient representation, good/bad inclusions and free-norm comparison (lem:absorption, lem:ambient, lem:good-inclusion, lem:free-norm, lem:bad-inclusion) supply the closeness and common bicommutant of the Cstar construction.
